definitions.production: actual native main-grid deposition counter differences, cross-checked against current primary sources and live rho charge
definitions.gather: native safe main-grid gather predicate immediately before serial primary mover; exact source XY order and values unchanged since deposition
definitions.snapshot: all primary source copies drift-synchronized to the displayed frame; no thinning
definitions.scope: primary e+e- beam sources; produced incoherent pairs are tracked test particles and are not deposited field sources
definitions.charge_roundoff_model: u32+(1+u32)*gamma_(8N+32), u32=epsilon(float)/2, gamma_k=k*epsilon(PHI_FLOAT)/2/(1-k*epsilon(PHI_FLOAT)/2); N=deposited sources; zero sources require zero charge
